data.name: Evangelia
data.gender_notes: Evangelia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'evangelion', meaning 'good news' or 'gospel'. In Christianity, the term 'evangelist' refers to someone who spreads the gospel message. The name Evangelia carries the meaning “Good News” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evangelia usually hope their child will grow to embody good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of good news and hope
data.etymology: Evangelia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evangelia total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אבנגליה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אבנגליה נגזר מהמילה 'אבנגליון' שפירושה 'בשורה טובה' או 'חדשות טובות'. הוא קשור להפצת בשורת ישועת אלוהים והבטחתו הנצחית לאנושות. השם משקף את המשמעות של להיות נושא בשורה משמחת ומקור של השראה רוחנית.

in_greek.name: Ευαγγελία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ευαγγελία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'Ευαγγέλιον', που σημαίνει 'καλά νέα' ή 'χάρισμα'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την παράδοση και τη διάδοση του Χριστιανικού μηνύματος, αντανακλώντας τη χαρά και την ελπίδα που προσφέρει η πίστη. Στην Εκκλησία των πρώτων χρόνων, το όνομα αυτό συμβόλιζε τη μετάδοση της σωτηρίας και της αγάπης του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Evangelia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Evangelia derivatur ex voce 'Evangelium', quod 'bonum nuntium' seu 'gaudium' significat. Hoc nomen intimam habet connexionem cum traditione Christiana et diffusione fidei, denotans gaudium et spem quae ex fide in Deum proveniunt. In primitiva Ecclesia, hoc nomen significabat transmissionem salvationis et amoris Dei.
